reason: README quickstart offers CPU-capable paddlespeech asr/tts CLI with small pretrained models auto-downloaded.
demo: README Quick Start: paddlespeech asr and paddlespeech tts CLI
goal: Install PaddleSpeech from the repo clone (CPU paddlepaddle) so the `paddlespeech` CLI works. Download https://paddlespeech.cdn.bcebos.com/PaddleAudio/zh.wav and run `paddlespeech asr --lang zh --input zh.wav`, which must print the Chinese transcript. Also run `paddlespeech tts --input "你好，欢迎使用百度飞桨深度学习框架！" --output output.wav` which must produce a valid wav file. Both must work on CPU.
check: The hidden test runs the asr CLI on zh.wav expecting the correct transcript, and the tts CLI expecting a valid non-trivial WAV file.
